findings.title: x
findings.message: Stop() waits for f.done, but the ticker goroutine only exits on ctx.Done or a closed-window error. Stop runs after Run returns, and f.stop is called first, so this is fine. However, if the PostWindow queue is full (QueueCapacity small) errors are silently ignored and checkpoints are dropped, hiding recovery failures.
findings.suggestion: Log or surface persistent PostWindow errors other than closed-window errors.

findings.title: Pre-existing directory permission handling
findings.message: MkdirAll does not tighten permissions on a pre-existing directory, and Lstat ensures only that the directory itself is not a symlink. The check is fine, but os.UserConfigDir is used as the default; if the user's Application Support directory is acceptable, this is fine. The real issue is that Notebook.vellumnotes is opened via a user-chosen path in Save As, with no restrictions. Low risk.
findings.suggestion: Document the behavior or chmod the directory.
